Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1089
Claimant:
James Castillo
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
28 Mar 2023
Claim opened after a rear-end collision at a traffic signal. The policyholder's vehicle was struck from behind, and the
claimant, who is not represented by counsel, reports neck and back pain following the impact.
30 Apr 2023
Reviewed the police report and the statements from two independent witnesses. Both confirm the collision occurred
as described and that the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time.
15 May 2023
Photographs from the scene and the other driver's account match the reported impact. The rear damage to the
vehicle is consistent with a collision of this type, and no earlier damage to this area is known from prior claims or
records.
18 May 2023
A repair estimate from before the policy start date lists damage to the same rear area of the vehicle. This conflicts
with the assumption that the damage came from this collision and needs to be followed up with the repair shop.
25 Jul 2023
Spoke with the claimant, who has added a few small details about the sequence of events. The core account has not
changed from the first report.
16 Sep 2023
The claimant's treatment record shows a usual course of care for a neck and back strain, with visits tapering off as
symptoms improved. No prior injury to the same body area is known, and the reported injury is plausible for a crash of
this severity.
20 Sep 2023
The drvier is a household member of the policyholder and qualifies for coverage under the policy terms. Recommend
holding the file open pending review of the pre-policy repair estimate before any settlement offer is made.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
